name: takku
description: Your meetings recorded with Takku in Codex: list them, search what was said and read a note with its transcript, from the notes folder on your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Search and read the meetings you recorded with Takku
interface.longDescription: Takku records meetings on your Mac, transcribes them locally and writes a Markdown note for each. This plugin lets Codex list those meetings by date, title or participant, search what was said in the summaries, notes and transcripts, and read a meeting in full. It reads the notes folder chosen in Takku's Settings through the read-only MCP server built into Takku 1.14.0 or later: Takku does not need to be running, and nothing is changed. Requires Takku in /Applications.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about the release in last week's meetings?
